concept.title: Product Overview
concept.shortdesc: The GrainFlow X50 is a high-capacity grain cleaning system designed for industrial agricultural operations.

section.title: Introduction
section.p: The GrainFlow X50 is a state-of-the-art machine that efficiently separates impurities from grains using precision airflow and advanced screening technology. It is part of the GrainFlow Series.

ul.li: Throughput: Up to 80 tonnes per hour
Energy Consumption: 15% more efficient than previous models
IoT Enabled: Remote monitoring via Bühler Connect
Safety: Advanced safety interlocks and emergency stop system

section.title: Applications
section.p: The GrainFlow X50 is suitable for:

section.title: Standard Model
section.p: The standard model offers throughput up to 50 tonnes per hour with basic IoT monitoring.

section.title: Advanced Model
section.p: The advanced model offers throughput up to 80 tonnes per hour with enhanced IoT capabilities including predictive maintenance alerts.
